scope: Core pump-product domain only; this file neither changes nor overrides Business APIs, Ontology, Domain Policy, or runtime behavior.
authorityOrder: current formal Business Code / Business API behavior

concepts.label: 定子组合
concepts.definition: A physical stator variant, uniquely defined in current storage by standard diameter, material, and slot type. commonName is a designation, not the physical identity.
concepts.notDefinition: Not a winding scheme, not a coil inventory record, and not a finished pump.

evidence.section: 1. 业务对象 / 定子组合

concepts.label: 绕组方案（正式线圈方案）
concepts.definition: A formal winding/rotor scheme belonging to a stator variant and carrying sheet count, lifecycle, technical, selection, cost, and stock attributes. Its canonical database identity is coils.id; scheme_code is a stable business scheme code.
concepts.notDefinition: Not merely the common designation spec-sheets, and not a generic Part record.

evidence.section: 1. 业务对象 / 绕组方案

concepts.label: 线圈转子（本系统语境）
concepts.definition: The business-facing inventory and cost object represented by a formal COIL_SCHEME record. The formal BOM row labels it 线圈转子 and uses inventoryType=coil only when a specific coilId exists.
concepts.notDefinition: Not a row in the ordinary parts catalogue and not a stator alone.

concepts.label: 泵壳模板
concepts.definition: A reusable pump-shell structure and its reusable fixed/component configuration. It can be costed as a shell bundle or as shell components plus fixed parts; it is not a complete recipe BOM.
concepts.notDefinition: Not an independently sellable finished pump configuration and not a recipe-specific configuration.

concepts.label: 配方（可生产成品配置）
concepts.definition: The persisted, named, product-level configuration that binds a template and optionally a precise coil scheme, carries configuration and technical fields, and persists a rebuilt BOM/cost snapshot on formal save.
concepts.notDefinition: Not just a template, not only a cost number, and not an unbound collection of parts.

concepts.label: 正式 BOM / 物料与配置组成
concepts.definition: A configuration-expanded list of material, coil, and process/cost rows produced by buildRecipeBomDraft and persisted as recipes.parts_json when a recipe is formally saved. It is the composition used for formal costing and production-related flows.
concepts.notDefinition: Not synonymous with Template and not synonymous with Recipe; a template contributes inputs and a recipe owns configuration plus a saved BOM snapshot.

identity.rowIdentity: partId when a Part-backed item is uniquely bound; coilId for a formal coil row; some rows are non-Part business/cost rows

concepts.label: 零件目录项
concepts.definition: A catalogued physical part with model, category, subcategory, supplier, current price, and on-hand stock. Stable identity is parts.id; model alone is a non-unique designation and supplier participates in exact fallback binding.
concepts.notDefinition: Not every BOM row, and not a coil scheme inventory record.

concepts.label: 成品泵（业务概念）
concepts.definition: The current code uses a Recipe's named, saved configuration as the production-facing finished-product configuration. No separate canonical finished_pump table or active Ontology entity was found in this core-domain audit.
concepts.notDefinition: Not a Template, and not necessarily the same as a free-form model name or a pump_model_variant preset.

evidence.note: Recipe is used as the finished-model search target.

attributes.label: 标准定子直径
attributes.definition: Physical stator diameter in millimetres.

attributes.label: 定子材质
attributes.definition: One of the formal material values used with stator identity.

attributes.label: 槽眼
attributes.definition: One of the formal slot types used with stator identity.

attributes.label: 规格俗称
attributes.definition: Stored common designation component; it is not a canonical scheme identity.

attributes.label: 片数
attributes.definition: Positive sheet count for the scheme; it is not power or inventory quantity.

attributes.label: 方案编码
attributes.definition: Stable per-scheme code; a canonical business identifier in addition to coils.id.

attributes.label: 方案系列编码
attributes.definition: Selection/binding attribute for calculated interpolation or extrapolation when an exact scheme is absent; it is not itself a universal scheme identity.

attributes.label: 方案状态
attributes.definition: Lifecycle status controlling ordinary eligibility: official, testing, or disabled.

attributes.label: 默认方案标记
attributes.definition: Optional default selection among official schemes in a bounded stator-and-sheet scope; it cannot override explicit criteria.

attributes.label: 额定电压
attributes.definition: Recorded electrical design attribute, not a universal identity key by itself.

attributes.label: 额定频率
attributes.definition: Recorded electrical design attribute, not a universal identity key by itself.

attributes.label: 主副线绕组数据
attributes.definition: Main/auxiliary wire gauge and wire data held as technical attributes.

attributes.label: 默认电容与电缆横截面积
attributes.definition: BOM input/default matching attributes; default_wire_gauge is documented as cable cross-section in mm².

evidence.section: 1. 业务对象 / 绕组方案

attributes.label: 线圈成本输入
attributes.definition: Calculated schemes use unit price, sheets, wire weight, copper base, coil fee, and rotor fee; kit schemes use kit price.

attributes.label: 壳型
attributes.definition: Unique template designation.

attributes.label: 模板成本模式
attributes.definition: components means priced shell components; bundle means a bundle cost for a bound pump-shell Part.

attributes.label: 产品级配置
attributes.definition: Persisted recipe inputs include template, coil, float, cable, packing, optional parts, barrel, impeller, technical data and applicable wages/settings.

attributes.label: 配方成本与 BOM 快照
attributes.definition: saved_total_cost and parts_json represent persisted save-time outputs; current recalculation is a distinct formal concept.

attributes.label: 零件型号
attributes.definition: A searchable but non-unique designation.

attributes.label: 供应商
attributes.definition: Participates in exact fallback catalog identity matching when a stable partId is absent.

attributes.label: 零件分类
attributes.definition: Formal classification used by services, including pump shell and shell-component validation.

relations.label: 绕组方案归属定子组合
relations.definition: A coil record optionally references a stator variant.

relations.label: 配方使用模板
relations.definition: A recipe optionally binds one pump-shell template; a template can be reused by multiple recipes in the data model.

relations.label: 配方选择线圈方案
relations.definition: A recipe optionally binds a specific formal coil scheme.

relations.label: 配方展开为 BOM
relations.definition: Formal recipe saving builds an authoritative BOM and persists its rows as parts_json.

relations.label: BOM 引用零件
relations.definition: Part-backed BOM rows carry a stable partId after formal identity binding; some BOM rows are not ordinary Part rows.

relations.label: 模板绑定泵壳零件
relations.definition: A template may bind at most one canonical pump-shell Part through a unique binding table.

relations.label: 模板贡献固定件
relations.definition: Template parts_json contributes fixed material rows when a recipe BOM is built.

relations.label: 模板贡献泵壳搭配组件
relations.definition: Template shellComponentsJson contributes bundle or component-cost rows to the expanded BOM.

relations.label: 配方承载可生产成品配置
relations.definition: Operationally inferred from formal recipe saving and order/cost use; a dedicated finished-pump entity is absent.

relations.label: 配方具有技术档案
relations.definition: Recipe technical data is persisted in technical_data_json and formally described by the recipe Ontology profile.

unresolved.label: 独立成品泵实体
unresolved.definition: No dedicated finished-pump table/entity was found; whether the Owner wants a distinct business concept beyond Recipe is a business decision.

unresolved.label: 老板日常语言中的模板粒度
unresolved.definition: Code proves storage and composition behavior but cannot determine the Owner's intended shop-floor meaning of 模板.

unresolved.label: V550 等名称的业务语义
unresolved.definition: Code binds recipe.name but does not determine whether every designation should mean market product model, recipe revision, or both.
